    "For a 90-day paying-customer goal, a bounded AI task (document extraction) for a known buyer beats a two-sided marketplace. A marketplace needs liquidity on both sides before anyone pays, and Idea B's own brief says AI coding tools are eroding its core need.",
    "Idea A has real risks: a small in-state market of 188 licensees, five or more direct competitors, scope creep toward full claim-lifecycle management, and Wisconsin data-security and breach-notification obligations. The only paid comparable is an adjacent category ($29/mo CoFoundersLab, cited through a roundup site), and its acquisition-cost estimate of $100–200 per paying customer comes from a vendor blog the brief itself labels 'not independently verified.'",

If that commitment is informal, A's lead narrows, but A remains stronger because its comparable pricing and buyer are sourced."
